author: MaxHax
quote: The game is an overall disappointment and honestly a downgrade form gta V the visuals arent nearly as impressive as in the trailer and that **** that has been awaited for 13 years, they also couldn’t not get the bugs out with several occasions of falling through walls and floors. It runs at a measly 30 fps and cannot take the explosions that most people come to gta for. The voice acting is just bad there are tons of awkward silences and points where I dont even see the lips lining up with the dialogue. Overall disappointment for the most anticipated game of all time. The other features are pretty decent like the guns and fighting and thats why its not a 3 or below

author: MaxHax
quote: I have played the 3ds remake of ocarina of time a month or 2 before buying this game and this is the best 70 dollars I have spent this year. Nintendo truly cooked on this they improved the graphics greatly improved and although the new designs for the characters were not my favorite at first they grew on me. Playing through the quest again was amazing. The camera is amazing I was so frustrated with the camera in the 3ds version. The game also felt amazing in terms of its controls it was so smooth and the story is still amazing. Next the voice acting felt so good the choices for voice actors were great especially Navi who sounded just as annoying as in the original. As usual The Legend of Zelda does not disappoint with being a darker side for a nintendo game and I cannot wait to see what they do in the future. The game was so fun that when I picked it up I couldnt set it down and ended up beating the main story in 10 hours with slight dilly dallying as a person who already played an older version of the game. I will be changing this review to a 9 later if they don’t end up adding master quest though. Great experience overall and I definitely will be playing another play through especially if they add a master quest.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
